# `disposition-rule` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "disposition-rule" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/disposition-rule/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | The event type this rule answers, e.g. "attacked", "fed". Unique; stable once shipped. |
| `notes` | string | required | Why this event moves disposition, and by this much. |
| `delta` | integer -200–200 | required | Change in disposition when the event happens (−100..100 scale; the result clamps). |
